- memory_id "1001201" [decision]: On 2026-05-04, Team Boreal decided that the event bus will retain messages for seven days because replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far.  (about: Team Boreal, event bus)

- memory_id "1001082" [constraint]: As of 2026-02-23, the scheduler's deploy window remains weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC.  (about: scheduler)
- memory_id "1001017" [decision]: The INC-2026-003 review on 2026-01-22 decided that the webhooks service will require an idempotency key on every delivery because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one.  (about: webhooks service, INC-2026-003, idempotency key)
- memory_id "1001009": INC-2026-003 was an incident in which the webhooks service delivered some events twice on 2026-01-17.  (about: webhooks service, INC-2026-003)
- memory_id "1000962": On 2025-12-23, Team Atlas noticed that the billing service's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Atlas, billing service)
- memory_id "1000815" [constraint]: As of 2025-10-27, the scheduler deploys on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC.  (about: scheduler)
- memory_id "1000776" [decision]: The INC-2025-023 review on 2025-10-16 decided that reindex jobs will page on failure.  (about: INC-2025-023, reindex jobs)
- memory_id "1000765": INC-2025-023 was an incident affecting the indexer on 2025-10-13.  (about: indexer, INC-2025-023)
- memory_id "1000757": As of 2025-10-15, the scheduler is owned by Team Dune; Team Atlas kept it until then.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Dune, scheduler)
- memory_id "1000753": As of 2025-10-15, the pager for the scheduler rings Team Dune instead of Team Atlas.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Dune, scheduler)
- memory_id "1000709" [decision]: On 2025-09-15, Team Dune decided that the reporting service will read from the event bus instead of querying the ledger directly because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: ledger, Team Dune, event bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000697": On 2025-09-08, Team Boreal observed that the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Boreal, notifier, clients)
- memory_id "1000543": On 2025-07-03, Team Atlas noticed that the resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Atlas, resizer)
- memory_id "1000470" [decision]: As of 2025-06-13, the scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node, because the fixed node turned every restart into a missed run.  (about: scheduler)
- memory_id "1000464": On 2025-06-12, Team Dune noticed that the notifier's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Dune, notifier)
- memory_id "1000286": The scheduler pulls per-job kill switches from the feature-flags service on every run.  (about: feature-flags service, scheduler)
- memory_id "1000150": INC-2025-004 was an incident affecting the notifier on 2025-02-06.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
